column1: # AUTO-GENERATED by tools/datamine_esd_gates.py -- NPC dialogue item gifts (AwardItemLot)
# from ESDLang-decompiled talk ESD. gate_flag with gate_sense==0 is the 'not yet
# received' acquisition flag; item_lot is the ItemLotParam handed over; talk_id ->
# NPC map -> region (join as in datamine_merchant_shops). One row PER GATE PATH.
# Lots resolve through the ESD call chain (assert t.._x3(lot1=N) -> AwardItemLot(lot1));
# a literal-only read finds 6 of the lots below. NO NEW CHECKS -- every lot with an
# acquisition flag is already in region_map.csv; the value is PROVENANCE (who hands
# it over, behind which flag, on which map) and PLACEMENT for the PENDING rows.
# MEASURED THIS RUN (recomputed on every emit):
#   105 sites (6 literal, 99 param) | 298 rows | 128 distinct lots
#   lots: 49 live AP checks | 9 NOT_RANDOMIZED | 39 region_map-PENDING (this
#   table is their placement source) | 0 placed-not-live | 0 unknown-flag |
#   31 with no acquisition flag (invisible to the flag poll)
